stories.title: Walker Police Chief Brandyn Huegel outlines future plans, including drones and new K-9 officer
stories.summary: Brandyn Heugel, newly sworn in as Walker's police chief, plans to advance drone tech, introduce the city's first K-9 and address smart tech concerns.

stories.title: Man arraigned in 2021 Kalamazoo shooting that killed 1, injured another
stories.summary: Willie Stephon-Flynn Blackwell, 22, was arraigned on open murder charges on Friday.

stories.title: Semi-truck leaks fuel after crash in Grand Rapids
stories.summary: Multiple crews were called to Market Avenue Tuesday morning to clean up the fuel.

stories.title: Man sentenced to 30 days in jail for racist rant targeting woman in Aldi parking lot
stories.summary: Randall Lee Miller was charged with a hate crime after the rant, in which he threatened a Black woman and used racial slurs.

stories.title: Electric Forest returning to Rothbury in 2027 despite community pushback
stories.summary: The pushback comes after an infant was found dead in a porta-potty. Residents have also expressed concerns about safety, policing and the size of the festival.

stories.title: AAA offering free rides over Thanksgiving weekend to keep impaired drivers off the road
stories.summary: The Tow to Go program will provide a ride and tow within a 10-mile radius. It is meant to be a last resort for people who are too impaired to drive.

stories.title: 'ENLIGHTEN' holiday light show returns for 3rd year at Meijer Gardens
stories.summary: Meijer Gardens staff say the light show is becoming a tradition for some families. It runs through Jan. 10.

stories.title: Suspected drunk driver injured in rollover crash in Mecosta Co.
stories.summary: The driver, a 47-year-old Rodney man, was taken to a hospital with minor injuries. He was later arrested for operating while intoxicated.

stories.title: New Walker police chief sworn in
stories.summary: Brandyn Heugel, who has been serving as interim chief, was unanimously chosen as the next police chief by the Walker City Commission. She was sworn in Monday.

stories.title: Godwin Heights Board of Education holds first meeting since student's fatal crash
stories.summary: Godwin Heights Public Schools superintendent, Chad Conklin, shared a message of support for the grieving family and school community during Monday's meeting.

stories.title: Gerald R. Ford Presidential Express returns for the holidays
stories.summary: The Gerald R. Ford Presidential Express, a tribute to Ford's Michigan legacy, returns to the museum Nov. 27 through Jan. 3, 2027.

stories.title: Muskegon Heights council moves forward on interim city manager search, debates vacant mayor's seat
stories.summary: Muskegon Heights leaders voted to interview two interim city manager candidates but took no action on the city's vacant mayoral seat Monday night.
